name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
oracle_text:
Flying
If an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much life instead. (Damage causes loss of life.)
blocked_sentences: If an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much life instead. (Damage causes loss of life.)

needs.what: a static ability on a permanent that replaces life-loss events for a chosen set of players -- an event-modifying continuous effect that intercepts every life-loss a player is about to suffer (including the life loss caused by damage, and life paid as a cost) and substitutes a scaled amount, here doubled, gated by an 'as long as it is your turn' condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has no entry that touches life totals at all -- the only replacement-shaped members of the vocabulary are prevent_damage (which reduces damage, is not a doubler, and would miss non-damage life loss such as Sign in Blood or paid life), plus the ops replace_deaths and replace_leaves_battlefield, which replace zone changes for permanents rather than events on players. The life_lost trigger event is a trigger, not a replacement: it fires after the loss has already been applied, so an additional lose_life op would deal the second half as a separate later event (visible to other life-loss triggers, and re-triggering itself), which is not the same as the printed 'lose twice that much life instead'.
